name: Danganronpa Antebellum: Lockdown
source:
12 Ultimates wake up in a strange Prison, with every moment of their lives now livestreamed to a wider audience ready to see them face justice... After all, they're all secretly Criminals. Follow these 12 Ultimates as their crimes are slowly uncovered in a game of life and death, deciding whether or not they're worthy of a chance at Redemption.

Follow Shinku Kutsuki, a disgraced Crime Novelist, as he comes to terms with the skeletons in his closet and attempts to understand his fellow Prisoners and what's really going on here, what people are willing to do for audience favor... And who he can really trust. 

Will he be worthy of Redemption?

Complete reimagining of [url=/v38940]Danganronpa: Antebellum[/url].
